dynamic_content_masking.rationale: Chart bars, labels, and selected datum are fixture data and are evaluated for structure rather than pixel identity.
Cell values are deterministic fixture content but may vary with selected-column state.
Clock and connectivity indicators are runtime-owned.

perceptual_comparison.notes: Runtime header preserves the approved centered title field, current-view CTA, type/column label, and compact Options control.
Runtime plot is populated, includes labels and a zero-inclusive grid, and selected bars receive a visible outline.
Runtime grid now shows fixture rows at compact 48dp heights instead of an oversized blank region.
First-level capture visibly contains the three required action rows.
Second-level capture visibly contains back navigation, supporting text, and two radio choices.
Empty state retains recovery CTAs; selected state shows a contained tooltip row with a 48dp dismiss control.
Dark read-only capture retains inspection and removes destructive mutation controls.

defect_classification.description: Data grid previously appeared blank and oversized.
defect_classification.suggested_fix: Bound the scroll container and use fixed 48dp data rows.
Capture first-level and second-level sheets separately.

defect_classification.description: Tooltip dismiss target previously overlapped the tooltip.
defect_classification.suggested_fix: Place the dismiss control inside a measured row with a 48dp target.

defect_classification.description: Negative values previously lacked a zero baseline.
defect_classification.suggested_fix: Use a zero-inclusive numeric domain for Bar and Line geometry.

defect_classification.description: Chart controls previously used generic tags and nested controls lacked tags.
defect_classification.suggested_fix: Scope tags with persisted block/column/row IDs and tag nested selectors.
